items.name: Burnaby Summer 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)

You are welcome to join the Facebook Group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**.

You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

**Notice of filming and photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

**Health and Safety:**
Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

items.name: Big Brain Minnesota 2025
items.information:
### There is no 3x3 at this competition

##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, and FMC.

[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota)
##### ____________________________________

Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space. 

The Library is only officially open from 1-5pm on Sunday. That means for people competing in 5x5 and 6x6 we will need to come and open the main library door for you to come in. Please keep an eye out for an email leading up to the competition for additional details on the venue.

## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español
   
## Bienvenido a Road to Nats Caracas 2025

**Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.**

* Límite de **55** competidores para el registro.
* Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia.
* **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsCaracas2025#62319-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla.
* Si tiene dudas, puede ver la pestaña de [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsCaracas2025#62320-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) o contactar al equipo organizador.

## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English 
## Welcome to Road to Nats Caracas 2025

**Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.**

* Competitor registration limit: **55**.
* It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience.
* **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsCaracas2025#62319-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) for you. It is very important to read it.
* If you have any questions, you can check [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsCaracas2025#62320-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) or contact the organizing team.
